basic_info.description: Set on a prestigious block in a storied neighborhood, brimming with San Francisco history & lore, this gorgeously renovated home is a mix of period detailing and modern updates. Detached on all sides, this home features breathtaking views from all rooms, spanning the full expanse from Downtown to the Bay and encompassing the hillscapes of Bernal and Noe.  Flooded w/natural light, this one of a kind home boasts an extensive remodel with no expense spared, from gourmet kitchen to spa bath. Spacious living room w/corner windows offers panoramic views of the city. Kitchen has been completely remodeled w/custom oak cabinetry, premium appliances, stone countertops & handmade tile. The dining area offers its own outlooks & opens to a large patio with lounge and dining. Gorgeous spa-like bath is clad in hand crafted tile & features a soaking tub, huge walk-in shower & new finishes. 3 large bedrooms (2 w/WI closets) all offer Downtown views. Addl features include new wide plank white oak floors, designer lighting & custom finishes throughout. (Unheard of!) 3 car parking in 2 private garages complete the home. Set on one of the best blocks in SF  and walkable to Valencia, Noe Valley, Duboce and of course Dolores Park, this home is perfectly situated to enjoy the best the city has to offer.
